iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-47.title: Article 47 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-47.conditions: The referral authority may remand the file to investigators for supplemental inquiries prior to directing court referral.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-48.title: Article 48 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-48.conditions: Jurisdictional conflicts between civil criminal courts and military tribunals are resolved definitively by the Federal Court of Cassation.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-49.title: Article 49 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-49.conditions: The Military Public Prosecutor may appeal dismissal or non-referral decisions to the Military Cassation Court within 30 days.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-50.title: Article 50 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-50.conditions: Flag officers (Brigadier General and above) are tried before a military court presided over by an officer of equal or senior rank with career judges.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-51.title: Article 51 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-51.conditions: The referral order, witness list, and trial date must be served upon the accused and defense counsel at least 7 days before trial.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-52.title: Article 52 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-52.conditions: The referral authority may amend the legal description of the charge based upon newly discovered facts and evidence.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-53.title: Article 53 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-53.conditions: The relevant ministry is notified immediately upon an officer's referral to court to arrange administrative relief and interim command.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-54.title: Article 54 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-54.conditions: Classified defense documents and operational plans are transmitted directly to the court president via secure diplomatic military courier.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-55.title: Article 55 - Referral Authorities and Court Transmission
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-55.conditions: Promotion and annual increments are suspended from the date of the referral order until a final definitive judgment is rendered.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-56.title: Article 56 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-56.conditions: Hearings of military courts are public, unless the court decides to proceed in camera to safeguard operational defense secrets or order.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-57.title: Article 57 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-57.conditions: The military court is constituted with a presiding officer and two military judges, attended by the military prosecutor and court clerk.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-58.title: Article 58 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-58.conditions: Presence of defense counsel is mandatory in all felony trials; the court appoints counsel at state defense expense if unrepresented.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-59.title: Article 59 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-59.conditions: Trial begins with the reading of the indictment and interrogating the defendant as to whether he pleads guilty or not guilty, without oath.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-60.title: Article 60 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-60.conditions: If the defendant makes a voluntary and unambiguous confession, the court may accept the plea and proceed to sentencing.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-61.title: Article 61 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-61.conditions: The court examines prosecution witnesses, and the defendant and his counsel have the right to cross-examine each witness.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-62.title: Article 62 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-62.conditions: The court calls and examines defense witnesses requested by the accused or counsel, recording testimonies verbatim in court minutes.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-63.title: Article 63 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-63.conditions: The court may appoint ballistics, ordnance, and communications experts to present technical assessments on specialized military evidence.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-64.title: Article 64 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-64.conditions: The accused shall always have the final statement, and defense counsel delivers the closing argument prior to closing deliberations.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-65.title: Article 65 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-65.conditions: Deliberations are conducted in absolute secrecy; judgments are adopted by majority vote, the president casting the deciding vote if tied.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-66.title: Article 66 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-66.conditions: Sentences of capital punishment (death) require unanimous agreement of all tribunal members; lack of unanimity commutes to life imprisonment.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-67.title: Article 67 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-67.conditions: Judgments are rendered in the Name of the People and read publicly in open court, stating findings of fact, statutory clauses, and penalties.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-68.title: Article 68 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-68.conditions: Judgments are entered into the military register and signed by the president, all panel members, and the court clerk immediately.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-69.title: Article 69 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-69.conditions: The court explains to the convict his right to lodge a cassation appeal within thirty (30) days from judgment pronouncement.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-70.title: Article 70 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-70.conditions: In-absentia trials proceed against fugitive personnel following public notice; in-absentia convictions fall upon arrest or surrender.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-71.title: Article 71 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-71.conditions: Courtroom discipline and decorum are entrusted to the presiding judge, who may exclude disrupters and impose immediate summary contempt sanctions.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-72.title: Article 72 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-72.conditions: Court minutes recorded by the clerk reflect all procedures, evidence, motions, and pleas, enjoying authoritative evidentiary validity.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-73.title: Article 73 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-73.conditions: If an offense is committed inside the courtroom during a session, the tribunal may summarily convict the offender or refer him for investigation.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-74.title: Article 74 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-74.conditions: Witnesses and defense attorneys enjoy qualified judicial immunity for factual arguments and statements made in good faith in court.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-75.title: Article 75 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-75.conditions: Trial proceedings are stayed if the defendant is certified mentally incompetent to stand trial, ordering placement in a psychiatric hospital.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-76.title: Article 76 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-76.conditions: The military tribunal may adjudicate joined civil damage claims submitted by victims or state entities arising directly from the crime.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-77.title: Article 77 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-77.conditions: The court orders restitution of seized properties to rightful owners in its final judgment, unless subject to statutory confiscation.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-78.title: Article 78 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-78.conditions: The tribunal, upon finding substantiated judicial mitigating grounds, may commute death to life imprisonment or reduce custodial penalties.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-79.title: Article 79 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-79.conditions: The court enters a verdict of acquittal if innocence is proven, or dismisses for insufficient evidence, interpreting all doubts in favor of the accused.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-80.title: Article 80 - Trial Sessions, Evidence, and Defense Guarantees
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-80.conditions: Case files involving death or life imprisonment are automatically transmitted to the Military Cassation Court for mandatory review without appeal.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-81.title: Article 81 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-81.conditions: The Military Court of Cassation headquartered in Baghdad is established, composed of senior military judges to review military appeals.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-82.title: Article 82 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-82.conditions: The time limit for filing a cassation appeal is thirty (30) days, commencing the day following in-person pronouncement or service of default judgment.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-83.title: Article 83 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-83.conditions: Grounds of cassation appeal include breach of statutory law, erroneous application or interpretation, essential procedural defect, or defective reasoning.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-84.title: Article 84 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-84.conditions: The Military Cassation Court may affirm the verdict, quash it and remand for retrial, or reduce the sentence in accordance with law.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-85.title: Article 85 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-85.conditions: The Military Cassation Court cannot aggravate the penalty if the appeal was lodged solely by the convict without cross-appeal by the prosecution.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-86.title: Article 86 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-86.conditions: The convict or the prosecution may petition for rectification of a cassation decision within 30 days based on grave substantive error of law.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-87.title: Article 87 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-87.conditions: Retrial (motion for reconsideration) of final convictions may be petitioned if newly discovered evidence conclusively establishes innocence.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-88.title: Article 88 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-88.conditions: Interlocutory procedural orders rendered during trial cannot be appealed independently from the final judgment disposing of the action.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-89.title: Article 89 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-89.conditions: The En Banc Full Bench of the Military Cassation Court adjudicates capital executions, landmark legal controversies, and trials of general officers.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-90.title: Article 90 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-90.conditions: The Chief Military Cassation Prosecutor presents a reasoned written brief on every dossier reviewing legality and recommending disposition.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-91.title: Article 91 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-91.conditions: Decisions of the Military Court of Cassation rendered within its jurisdiction are definitive, res judicata, and immediately enforceable.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-92.title: Article 92 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-92.conditions: If a judgment is quashed and remanded a second time, the trial court must conform strictly to the directives of the Cassation Court.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-93.title: Article 93 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-93.conditions: A cassation appeal automatically stays the execution of capital sentences and custodial penalties until final determination.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-94.title: Article 94 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-94.conditions: Appeals may be formally lodged through the military garrison prison warden or unit commander, who must transmit it to court within 24 hours.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-95.title: Article 95 - Appellate Review and Military Court of Cassation
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-95.conditions: Military convicts and detained servicemen are fully exempt from judicial court fees for cassation appeals and retrial petitions.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-96.title: Article 96 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-96.conditions: Sentences of capital punishment (death) cannot be executed until ratified by presidential decree issued by the President of the Republic.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-97.title: Article 97 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-97.conditions: Execution is carried out by firing squad in a garrison or military prison, attended by the judge, prosecutor, physician, and clergy.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-98.title: Article 98 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-98.conditions: Execution of capital punishment is strictly barred on official national holidays and religious feast days of the convict's faith.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-99.title: Article 99 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-99.conditions: Execution of a pregnant female service member is deferred until childbirth and the completion of two years of nursing.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-100.title: Article 100 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-100.conditions: Sentences of confinement are executed within military prisons under the administrative supervision and inspection of military magistrates.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-101.title: Article 101 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-101.conditions: General amnesty extinguishes military convictions; executive pardon remits or commutes penalties without removing disciplinary stigmas.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-102.title: Article 102 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-102.conditions: The military prisoner is discharged immediately upon expiration of his term upon written certification from prison authorities.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-103.title: Article 103 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-103.conditions: Military Criminal Procedure Code No. 30 of 2007 is hereby repealed and superseded by this Code.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-104.title: Article 104 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-104.conditions: The Minister of Defense in concurrence with the Chief of Military Justice shall promulgate implementing regulations.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-105.title: Article 105 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-105.conditions: Judgments and judicial actions taken prior to the entry into force of this Code remain valid unless quashed on appeal.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-106.title: Article 106 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-106.conditions: Staffing establishments of military tribunals, cassation benches, and prosecution offices are organized under Cabinet regulations.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-107.title: Article 107 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-107.conditions: All state ministries, intelligence agencies, and armed units must facilitate the military judiciary's mission and execute its mandates.

iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-108.title: Article 108 - Enforcement of Sentences and Final Provisions
iraqi-military-procedure-code-2016-108.conditions: This Code shall enter into force from the date of its publication in the Iraqi Official Gazette (Al-Waqaei Al-Iraqiya) No. 4444 on April 24, 2017.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-1.title: Definitions and Scope of Regulation
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-1.conditions: This Regulation is promulgated to execute the provisions of Peshmerga Service and Retirement Law No. 38 of 2007, governing administrative affairs, promotion rosters, medical commissions, and service calculation.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-2.title: Service Verification and Auditing Boards
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-2.conditions: Central and sub-committees are constituted within the Ministry of Peshmerga to audit and authenticate personnel records and struggle service rendered prior to March 5, 1991.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-3.title: Officer Promotion Protocols and Rosters
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-3.conditions: Officer promotions are tabulated semiannually (Nowruz roster on March 21 and Army Day roster on January 6) upon fulfilling statutory time in rank, completing mandatory courses, and positive command evaluations.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-4.title: Enlistment Regulations and Military Discipline
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-4.conditions: All Peshmerga units adhere to regular military disciplinary standards, with mandatory periodic medical examinations evaluating physical fitness for operational deployment.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-5.title: Pension Processing and Severance Gratuity Workflow
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-5.conditions: The General Directorate of Peshmerga Pension Affairs finalizes retirement dossiers pursuant to Article 28 calculations and disburses end-of-service gratuities under Article 29 via the Ministry of Finance.

kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-6.title: Effective Date
kri-peshmerga-service-reg-2011-6.conditions: This Regulation shall be enforced from the date of issuance and published in the Official Gazette (Waqaei Kurdistan).

kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-4.title: Unification and Audit of Peshmerga Payroll and Establishment
kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-4.conditions:
First: Unification of all accounting units of Peshmerga forces within the official statutory framework of the Ministry of Peshmerga and Ministry of Finance.
Second: Comprehensive audit of Peshmerga personnel files to cleanse payrolls from duplicate or illicit entitlements.
Third: Mandatory electronic biometric verification linking salary payments to unique personal numbers (UPN).
Fourth: Re-audit of disability pension beneficiary rosters under Law No. 34 of 2007, canceling any unlawful entitlements.

kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-6.title: Regularization and Audit of Counted Revolutionary Service
kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-6.conditions: Re-verification and documentary auditing of all credited revolutionary struggle years pursuant to official archival proof and requirements under Laws No. 33 and 38 of 2007.

kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-9.title: Harmonization of Military Pensions Under 2007 Statutes
kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-9.conditions: Strict enforcement of Laws No. 33, 34, and 38 of 2007 regarding military retirement, invalidating fictitious ranks or allowances granted contrary to statutory procedures.

kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-10.title: Prohibition of Unlawful Dual Emoluments
kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-10.conditions: Strict prohibition against receiving multiple salaries or unauthorized allowances from the public treasury, requiring beneficiaries to rectify status within statutory deadlines.

kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-16.title: Legal Accountability and Penal Liability
kri-reform-law-2020-peshmerga-16.conditions: Any official or officer intentionally furnishing fraudulent records or enabling illicit disbursements shall be prosecuted before competent courts, with full restitution under government debt recovery statutes.

iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-1.title: Amendment of Article 1 (Coverage of Reservists and Duty Crimes)
iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-1.conditions: Clause (a) of Paragraph (First) is amended and Clause (e) added to Article 1 so that the code applies to active Armed Forces personnel for crimes committed during or resulting from service, and to active reservist officers and soldiers.

iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-2.title: Amendment of Article 7 (Definitions of Military Mutiny and Room Detention)
iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-2.conditions: Adds two new clauses to Article 7: Sixth: Military Mutiny: Refusal to obey lawful superior orders, violent resistance, or unlawful assembly to abstain from military duty; Seventh: Room Detention: Confinement of personnel to a dedicated quarter within camp bounds.

iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-3.title: Amendment of Article 10 (Original Penalties Structure)
iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-3.conditions: Amends execution protocols of capital punishment by firing squad, ensuring judicial guarantees and harmonizing life and temporary imprisonment provisions.

iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-4.title: Amendment of Article 15 (Mandatory and Discretionary Expulsion)
iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-4.conditions: Mandatory expulsion or contract annulment applies upon convictions of capital punishment, imprisonment, terrorism, or dishonorable crimes; discretionary upon simple confinement sentences; mandatory dismissal of officers losing commissioning criteria.

iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-5.title: Enforcement of First Amendment
iraqi-military-penal-amendment-2012-5.conditions: This amendment enters into force upon publication in Iraqi Official Gazette No. 4238 on May 7, 2012.
